implementation: Hash in bounded blocks; 2.16GiB aggregate input bytes must not be loaded together. Root owns scheduling. Preserve exact executed seal source/argv, partial result and first failure; no retry or quota increase is released.
scope: One finite source seal: streamed hashes of inherited installed libraries/frozen files and local source, exact preimage/diff/AST/literal/named-port checks, JSON/source metadata emission. No numerical DUT, compiler, preprocessor or EDA.
unchanged_future_budgets: This source-seal bound does not authorize or extend static compilation/runtime budgets.
